review_text: There is absolutely no value for money here. Almost 200 for a Frappuccino style ice blended drink and it is served in an 8 oz cup with 25% whipped cream... Pancit was barely enough for 2 even with rice added. But if you are not to particularly concerned about these things, it is a good place to chill for a while between trips to and from Davao Ecoland Bus Terminal, just a short walk it's a clean comfortable spot with a decent menu.

The iced matcha drink was disappointing—its pale color already showed it was low quality. Even after thorough mixing, powder still settled at the bottom and couldn't blend in. Unfortunately, the drink feels overpriced for what it delivers. We also ordered the Annipie breakfast and tocino, but both tasted like they had just been reheated, lacking freshness. Definitely not worth trying. On a positive note, the café itself is cozy and clean, but sadly, the food and drinks don't justify the price.

I had been to the Annipie in Abreeza Mall and it was a much better experience food wise. Our main course portions were very small and my Chicken Cordon Bleu was very dry. The Pork Binagoongan was flavorful, but a very small serving. Also tried the Cool Cucumber Slush and it checked all the boxes; very good! On the positive side, the staff were helpful, friendly and courteous and the place was very clean.

Yes, they serve great cakes & cinnamons but did you know that they also offer other comfort food that are awesome tasting as well? Check out their unforgetable crispy palabok and their heavenly lomi that should leave you asking for more. Whole place is instagram-worthy so that makes it even more worth a visit or two. Or three.

All the foods on the menu are sumptuous. Carbonara is a must-try for pasta lovers. They have rice meals, sandwiches, pastas, pizzas, comfort foods, cakes, brownies, cinnamons and many more. Their coffees are also delightful. Parking space in front of the restaurant is available. They can cater to small birthday or family celebrations. They accept reservations. This is a must-try place if you are within the vicinity. They have clean facilities aside from the fact that the staff are courteous. The ambiance is likewise cozy.

I recommend ordering their Annipie breakfast platter. I love the cinnamon bun -- the cinnamon taste is not overpowering other flavors of the bread. Spanish latte and cafe mocha is also good -- worth the price ❤️

Have dined here for a quick lunch with family on a weekend. Food was just okay, nothing to be raved about. Maybe our choices in the menu were not that popular. I also like their cheese bars and brownies which I usually get as "takeouts" - value for money, priced quite lower than their competitors though at par with the taste.

Annipie is one of Davao City's most underrated restaurants. Many of their dishes can easily become homegrown staples because they taste like home and taste sooo good. Make sure to try Adobo Cream Pasta, Three Cheese Pizzatilla, Garlic Butter Chicken, and Cool Cucumber Shake. Don't forget to enjoy their Classic Cinnamon Roll (which can easily beat Cinnabon in terms of taste and price), as well as their wide array of cakes. Cheesecake De Leche is my absolute favorite, especially when paired up with brewed coffee. Design-wise, the restaurant is impeccably styled with wooden panel walls, faux grass ceiling, and clean architecture. The place is perfect for group meals or some alone time over a piece of cake.
Recommend if you wanted a relaxing place
